dc.title: Density of States of Gravitationally Active Grid Modes: Derivation of D_eff(ρ) and Completion of the Γ(ρ) Bridge
dc.creator: Morten Magnusson
dc.subject: density of states
gravitationally active modes
grid microphysics
entropy production function
Bose-Einstein statistics
activation dynamics
EFC
cosmology
dc.description: Derives D_eff(ρ) ∝ √(ρ/ρ_crit) from boundary-mode mechanism on a Higgs-stabilised grid lattice. Combined with BE per-mode entropy, gives Γ(ρ) = Γ₀√(ρ/ρ_crit)/(1+√(ρ/ρ_crit)) with ρ_crit = a₀/(G_N l_g). Scenario B+: microphysically derived, correct saturation, emergent ρ_crit, ~20% agreement with phenomenological ansatz.
